architecture.aps_policy: union of frozen base and FT APS class sets
architecture.failed_gate_behavior: set shortcut concentration to zero and span to 180 deg; retain the finite-budget search rather than directed transport
architecture.shortcut_confidence_envelope: rho_shortcut = min(rho_B, rho_F, abs(z_A)); confidence = min(conf_B, conf_F, conf_A)

claim_boundary: S4b train plus head-training-held-out validation diagnostics only; validation is the adapter-selection set, not a new test set. The M10 raw >90-degree posterior outlier remains but is abstained. No full-loop improvement or untouched pass is claimed.

data_access_contract.note: Frozen base/FT seed metrics include their pre-existing temperatures; the adapter selector never opens an S4b calibration trial or uses its labels.
data_access_contract.validation_role_semantics: held out from FT gradient updates, but used for adapter selection; not an untouched test set

selection_rule.candidate_order: ascending residual alpha, then ascending FT concentration floor
selection_rule.geometric_constant: base-FT circular means separated by more than 90 deg occupy opposite open half-planes, so directed transport abstains
hard_constraints_for_every_size_and_trai: accepted control-direction error >90 deg count equals zero
raw control-direction >90 deg count no worse than frozen FT
state accuracy no worse than frozen FT
selection_rule.objective: first feasible candidate = strongest base anchoring and then maximum shortcut coverage
